Profile Feeder provides a wealth of social profiles of celebrities, politicians, sportsmen, and more all under one roof. Some of the social sites found in Profile Feeder include Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram profiles.
Renkler means colors in Turkish. This site has colors for Turkey. Still developing. It uses related colors and palettes from COLOURlovers.
Contains elevation data for any mile marker or point along the Austin Marathon route. Also generates a terrain profile of the entire route.
Users from Germany, Austria and Great Britain can swap used DVDs, CDs, Books and Games. On the mashup map they can check out where their swap partners come from.

KinSync is a web application that automatically sends documents from a user's Mendeley account to their Kindle. The app resizes documents, formatting them to fit the Kindle's 6 screen. The app eliminates the extra step of downloading documents to a PC to then export to a Kindle. Users of KinSync may opt to only sync new documents so as to not clutter their Kindle with outdated content.
Track news coverage about anything and view trends on a chart. Combines the Daylife and Trendrr APIs.
Explore the Caribbean island of Barbados via Google Maps with nearly 300 points including beaches, accommodation, places of interest, golf courses and dive sites.
Online passport and visa photo service that provides guaranteed government compliance based on sophisticated biometrics.
Foreign markets and major US sector watch list gadget for iGoogle.
Allows users to preview files in their Box.net accounts using Increo Preview.
Rapid coding and collaboration tool that also integrates directly with the Basecamp task management service.
Alternative interface into the Amazon catalog. Java applet with price sliders and other filtering tools.

Adtegrity is a digital advertising solutions provider that delivers cross-screen advertising solutions for mobile video ads. Adtegrity's services include content strategizing, customers targeting, data optimizing and analysis.
A visually rich interactive Flash tool for exploring place based on the geotagged photos at Flickr. Search by user, tag and collection.
QuickBlox MapChat is a simple plugin for WordPress, that adds a MapChat (chat integrated with map) widget to your website. You can chat over a map or in chat room.
